in_sanskrit.name: श्रीकांत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: श्री (Shree) - Wealth, Prosperity, Goddess Lakshmi, Fortune, Auspicious, and कांत (Kant) - Protector, Guardian, Defender

in_hindi.name: श्रीकांत
in_hindi.meaning: श्री (Shree) - सद्गुण (sadgun) - Auspicious, Holy, Pious, Wealthy, Prosperous, Goddess Lakshmi, Fortune, Auspiciousness, and कांत (Kant) - रक्षाकार (rakshakaar) - Protector, Guardian, Defender

in_tamil.name: ஷ்ரீகாந்த்

in_telugu.name: శ్రీకాంట్
in_telugu.meaning: శ్రీ (Shree) - శోజేయోశ్చర్య (shojeYoshcharya) - Auspicious, Holy, Pious, Wealthy, Prosperous, and కాంట్ (Kant) - పేద్దదోటి (peddadoti) - Protector, Guardian

in_marathi.name: Shreekant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shreekant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shreekant is derived from two Sanskrit words - Shri, meaning God or wealth, and Kant, meaning desire or longing. Hence, Shreekant can be interpreted as the one who has a deep longing or desire for wealth and prosperity. It is also considered to be a name of Lord Vishnu.
